# `zipViaNestedFlatMapToAll`

Suggests Effect.all when a nested Effect.flatMap/Effect.map only pairs two independent effects

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377168` |
| Language Service name | `zipViaNestedFlatMapToAll` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/zip-via-nested-flat-map-to-all` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

declare const getUser: Effect.Effect<{ readonly id: string }>
declare const getOrders: Effect.Effect<ReadonlyArray<string>>

export const program = Effect.flatMap(getUser, (user) =>
/**
                       ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(zip-via-nested-flat-map-to-all): This nested `Effect.flatMap`/`Effect.map` only pairs two independent effects; use `Effect.all([...])` (sequential by default) to express this directly.
*/
  Effect.map(getOrders, (orders) => [user, orders] as const))
```
